meta.description: Request a link to reset your Palsya password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email address you use for Palsya and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, we've sent a reset link.
forgot.sentHint: The link expires in {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.

meta.title: Choose a new password — Palsya
meta.description: Set a new password for your Palsya account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a strong password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.tooLong: This password is too long. Use at most 72 characters.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The reset link is invalid or incomplete. Request a new one to continue.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Reset links are valid for {minutes} minutes. Request a new one to continue.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: Each reset link works only once. If you still need to change your password, request a new link.

errors.weak: The password doesn't meet all the requirements below.
errors.too_long: This password is too long. Use at most 72 characters.
errors.pwned: This password has appeared in a data breach. Please choose a different one.
errors.failed: We couldn't update your password. Please try again.

success.title: Password updated
success.body: Your password has been changed and you've been signed out on other devices. Taking you to sign in…
